responses.question: What are the risks of buying shares in hotel-managed properties instead of standard apartments?

9) Revenue concentration risk: If the project relies on a single tourism market, event calendar, or destination popularity, shocks can hit income fast.
10) Misaligned incentives: Some structures prioritize occupancy or operator revenue over owner cash flow, so the economics may not fully favor investors.

Compared with standard apartments, hotel-managed properties can resemble hospitality investments more than residential real estate.
